text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of acute sinusitis treated with antibiotics, and now you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever. To understand what is happening, did you notice any burning sensation during urination, urgency, or visible blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.
